issue.title: Freeze the scheduling clock in navigation picker-single P2 roll tests
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-5p.2 note #1 and bob-cli-5p.3 note #2. On bob-plugins master 9233b0cb717b3d09ba2de3da60a1eeb4528e4a22 (2026-10-08), node --test scripts/test-navigation-roll-decay.cjs fails exactly two nodes:
- picker-single Ctrl+Enter rolls a P2 task in one undo group (line 2073; assertion line 2087)
- picker-single opens on scheduled so Ctrl+Enter rolls with no navigation (line 2097; assertion line 2113)
Both expect [?] but get [ ] on a scheduled 2026-10-08 task; the date and Schedule Log otherwise match. Full isolated file: 53 passed, 2 failed. An unchanged-tree focused rerun also fails both. Evidence snapshot: file:explicit:d973ed74834aac4768839e70. Both phase reporters reproduced on their clean base. git diff 9233b0c^ 9233b0c -- plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys scripts/test-navigation-roll-decay.cjs is empty, so the failure is not caused by RECURRING.

Root cause: createRollPickerHarness fixes the recommendation/preview baseDate to 2026-09-30 but does not freeze the scheduling writer's wall clock. applyRecommendedRollWrite in src/390-picker-roll-write.js calls setBulletPropertyValue without options.today; src/580-plugin-properties-and-dependency-edit.js uses new Date() when options.today is absent. With the real date now 2026-10-08, the recommended schedule is due today and correctly remains Ready [ ] instead of Blocked [?]. Correct the test harness to provide one coherent frozen clock to recommendation and writer, preserving production's live-clock behavior. Test before, on, and after the scheduled day, using scoped clock restoration; do not simply change the expected checkbox to match the day the tests happen to run.

Size small: one test harness clock seam, two failures with the same cause. No active epic owns this cause: bob-cli-5p adds RECURRING overlay/nav behavior; bob-cli-28 and bob-cli-3j own unrelated capture/completion work.
